description: NT-12 rule (c): corpus decks that show no schema location, script or variant that another corpus deck lacks and that no known record or manifest feature names, each with a reason. check:native-coverage fails for such a deck that is not listed here, and for a listed deck that has since earned its place (or left the manifest). A new deck earns its place instead of joining this list.

decks.reason: An example of a 0.37.0 format change (format-requests program) added before its manifest feature: the coverage decks already show every location it uses. Name it in a feature with targets, or remove it from the manifest.
